title: Value Of Existence
paragraphs: “Delicious. Naofumi-chan.”
“Yeah.”
“I think I’ll eat a lot.”
“Go ahead and eat as much as you like.”
“Oh, I found some expensive alcohol. Naofumi-chan, let’s do a taste test again today.”
“Not a chance. Every night, enough is enough.”
With such a comical exchange, I approached Father.
“Hey! Naofumi!”
“…What is it?”
In a dramatic manner, I removed one glove and threw it at him. Looking back now, it was just a performance.
“A duel!”
“What are you talking about all of a sudden?”
Ah, Father. I’m sorry. Even though the opponent is the older sister of the big sister, I must fight in a way that mirrors the first world as much as possible.
“I heard! The beastman you’re with is a slave, right?!”
“Huh?”
The older sister of the big sister cheerfully took a sip of her drink. Well, from here on, there will be some changes…
As I pretended to be angry, I noticed that the older sister of the big sister was looking at me with a probing gaze.
…She hasn’t noticed, has she?
“So what?”
“‘So what?’… What do you mean by that?! Are you serious?!”
“Yeah.”
I already know the full situation. Moreover, the older sister of the big sister has very sharp instincts, so I have to be careful.
“She’s my slave. So what?”
“People… should not enslave other people! Even if she’s a beastman, as heroes from another world, we can’t allow such things!”
“What are you talking about… Slaves exist in our world, too.”
That response from Father reassured me a bit. It looks like we can duel just like in the first world.
“Not allowed? That might be true in your world, but here it’s different!”

Honestly, after seeing Father’s journey, I can’t help but think of the slave mark as a symbol of loyalty. If I could get one, I would want it too. If I ever returned to the first world, would I get one? I’d whisper it to Father. It would be the same mark as Filo-chan’s… I’d whisper it in his ear.
“Unfortunately, this is another world. Slaves exist here, too. What’s wrong with me using them?”
“Y-You!”
It’s really annoying when people get angry. In fact, I feel more irritated that I have to play along with this farce. I want to meet Filo-chan soon.
“A challenge! If I win, you’ll free her—no, that slave over there!”
“Why do we have to fight? What will happen if I win?”
“I’ll do whatever I want! Just like before!”
“This is pointless.”
That’s true… There’s no benefit for Father.
“By the way… Sadina just became my slave on her own, you know? Even if you remove the slave mark, it won’t change anything.”
“Huh?”
That’s how it will be, I suppose. But that’s something I don’t want to happen.
Should I say it now?
“Hehe, don’t you get it? You really don’t understand, do you?”
“…What do you mean by that?”
“I heard what Motoyasu-dono had to say.”
The scumbag entered the conversation and tried to restrain the older sister of the big sister using the kingdom’s soldiers.
“Huh, do you think you can restrain me?”
The soldiers were thrown back as the older sister of the big sister cast a spell, wrapping herself in lightning.
“Do you intend to defy my will?”
Father chuckled slightly at the older sister’s attitude.
“Do you think I’ll allow such foolishness from my sister?”
I deeply apologize, older sister of the big sister! I quickly thrust my spear toward her. Of course, I whispered the skill name so quietly that no one could hear.
“…Paralyze Lance II.”
The duration… I’ll wait until the duel with Father is over.
Should I show my true dark side?
“I’ve been watching you for a while, but this one… smells like a good woman.”

I switched to the Soul Eater Spear and used it to drain the older sister of the big sister’s magic with Soul Eater. The Soul Eater Spear has many uses and is quite convenient. Against an opponent with no SP, it drains magic. With an application, it can even pull out the soul. But I won’t extract the soul this time. The older sister’s transformation broke, and she reverted to her beastman form.
“Wh-What?”
Father is speechless. Well, I’m not sure how he’ll see this situation. It’s true that he had a fear of women, and he was apparently even scared of the big sister.
“If I win, Naofumi, I’ll free your woman and make her mine—strong and wonderful as I am. Either way, she’s too good for you. You filthy rapist.”
A sharp pain shot through my stomach.
Guh… I swallow to keep from spitting blood. Father grits his teeth and clenches his fist.
“If the slave doesn’t support their master, they’ll suffer. I’ll silence what the slave says.”
“…I still have to participate in the duel, right?”
“Why should I allow you to participate in the prize for the duel?”
“Wh-What?! You—”
“Then let’s have the duel in the castle’s courtyard!”

Well, the rest is just like the first world. Right now, Father’s balloon’s substitute attack doesn’t even hurt, but I pretended to be struggling. Then, as planned, the crimson swine provides supporting fire. I declare my victory, and Father shows a face full of murderous rage.
“Your comrades interfered in the duel! That’s why I stumbled!”
“Hah! Are you really whining like a loser?!”
“No, that’s not it! You’re a coward!”
I understand… this is my fault. And I apologize, Father… I can’t return to your side unless I do this. Now, I’ll pretend not to know anything and head to the crimson swine.
“Well… I was surprised back then too. To think that Myne was a princess, using an alias to sneak in.”
“Bu-bu-bu… Bubi-hi!”
To the older sister of the big sister, who is being restrained.
“I believe your name was Sadina, right?”
I then release the paralysis on the older sister of the big sister. The older sister of the big sister stands up and takes a drink from the alcohol she had been holding.
“…Fast Thunderbolt!”
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaa!”
The soldiers around the older sister of the big sister are thrown back from the lightning. She probably fired it off using the small amount of magic she had recovered. Heh, I’m unharmed.
“Hey… It seems like the older sister is getting a bit irritated…”
“How dare you do that to our soldiers!”
“Wait!”
I stop the scumbag and look at the older sister of the big sister.
“When did the older sister ask for help? The older sister stays with Naofumi-chan because she wants to, you know?”

I thought so. I know that. In fact, it was unexpected that the older sister of the big sister went against my prediction and forcefully turned herself into a slave. Ah, the older sister of the big sister. I would like to tell you that the older sister you’re looking for is under my protection. But, this is a trial, and I never expected it to be so painful not being able to do it.
“Well, but, Sadina-chan was being overworked by him, right?”
“Not at all. In fact, there were times when he let me do whatever I wanted, and Naofumi-chan always listened to me. It’s like… the older sister has to support him, or she can’t fight. It’s cute.”

Ugh… the older sister of the big sister, are you not aware of the phrasing here? This makes it seem like Father is leeching off the older sister of the big sister. Then, the older sister of the big sister whispers in my ear.
“I’d love to hear your purpose behind this fake acting of yours.”
Ah, she figured it out!

Just how high are her observational skills? But I can’t talk about this. It’s for meeting Filo-chan. If I could meet her, I’d be happy to hand over the older sister to you. I’ll show that I’m on Father’s side.
Yes! If I can meet Filo-chan before the older sister comes, I’ll reveal everything and stop the scumbag and the crimson swine right in front of Father.
“If you want to know, we’ll start the reconstruction of Reute Village with the Shield Hero tomorrow.”
I give that instruction. If I don’t, I have no idea what I’d do with Father.
“Huh? Isn’t that something we should naturally do? After experiencing the wave’s damage… The people of that village will help rebuild my village, right?”

Oh, the older sister of the big sister’s plans are ahead of the game. It seems like her focus is on the village’s reconstruction… and finding the older sister. The older sister of the big sister, in her beastman form, approaches Father and grabs his hand. She’s drinking alcohol to recover magic, but she’s still doing it in her beastman form.
“Let go!”
“Naofumi-chan. Calm down… I know you’re scared.”
“Let go of my hand!”

Does the older sister of the big sister not realize she can’t replace the older sister? I’m quite uneasy. If problems arise, I’ll target Ren or Itsuki. I’ll prepare the Brunak. Let’s aim for Ren and Itsuki, who’ll appear among the crowd.
“I didn’t do it!”
Then, the older sister of the big sister, just like the big sister, hugs Father from behind.
“Yeah. Naofumi-chan is not the type to do that. We haven’t known each other long, but I can tell that much.”
And so, it seemed like the older sister of the big sister was trying to persuade Father.
“Shut up! Are you trying to frame me again?!”
“Rumors are just rumors. If you’re together, you’ll quickly see the truth. You’ll know who’s at fault.”
The grim expression on Father’s face turned into one of surprise as he turned toward the older sister of the big sister.

“I believe in you. Yes, at first, I did think about using you, but now I love Naofumi-chan. That’s why I can say this: Naofumi-chan hasn’t done anything like what everyone says. I can state that for sure.”
Father’s pupils widened. He looked shocked.
“Yes, of course, if we’re together, you’ll know that, right?”
With a puff, the older sister of the big sister transformed into her beastman form and hugged Father.
“Now, the lack of a slave mark means the older sister can do whatever fun things she wants with Naofumi-chan without being punished, right? Maybe I’ll even try to attack Naofumi-chan.”
“Let go! Stop it!”
“…That’s how much the older sister loves Naofumi-chan, right? The only person who’s been willing to drink with me until the end is Naofumi-chan. I don’t want to let him go.”
Father gave a relieved expression toward the playful older sister of the big sister.
“The older sister trusts Naofumi-chan. So, is it wrong for us to be together? If you don’t trust me, should I go get another slave mark? The mark that proves Naofumi-chan’s love for me, okay?”

At that moment, Father began crying and weeping on the chest of the older sister of the big sister. From behind me, Ren and Itsuki appeared and explained my disqualification in the duel. I was well aware of that. Now, what’s bothering me is the older sister of the big sister. While holding Father, she’s giving off the aura of a wolf in front of her prey. I’m sure she plans to devour him afterward. The next day, Father was walking shyly, holding hands with the older sister of the big sister.

Did they do it? …Well, after receiving the reward the next day, I need to push Father into buying Sakura-chan’s eggs. With that in mind, I casually left the crimson swine behind at the castle and followed Father and the others. Ah, the monster merchant seemed to have noticed that and called out to Father right when he left the castle. It looks like he was offering to re-register the older sister of the big sister’s slave mark. After that… we’ll see how things turn out. If it fails, I’ll target Ren or Itsuki. Nothing to worry about, they won’t even realize they’ve been killed. As I was thinking that, it seems that, thanks to getting closer to the older sister of the big sister, Father intends to buy slaves and monsters. He had one familiar-looking slave from a village and the monster merchant gave him Sakura-chan’s eggs as a bonus. It looks like he’s planning to collect slaves from now on. Next, he has to use the excuse of staying at Reute Village. The older sister of the big sister seems to want to send him there. Well, Father and the others went to Reute Village and helped with the reconstruction work. They also registered Sakura-chan’s eggs, and now we’ll see how things turn out. It seems that the older sister of the big sister is in her beastman form more often now. Father is staying at Reute Village happily, planning to raise new slaves and Sakura-chan’s chicks.

It should be easier with the older sister of the big sister there, right? Thinking that, I quietly watched from the shadows to see how Sakura-chan would grow. Ah, of course, I’m checking on the older sister regularly. Depending on the situation, I’ll hand her over to Father. Then, just like in the first world, I passed by with the crimson swines while they were transporting goods.
Ah… it’s Sakura-chan in Filo-tan’s colors. Just as I was thinking that, the crimson swine pointed at Sakura-chan.
“Bu-bu-bu!”
And mocked her. I always want to kill him when I see that. I can’t laugh at Sakura-chan in Filo-tan’s colors. Sakura-chan glared at the crimson swine with a pout.
“You should get closer and laugh more.”
“Bu-bu-bu.”
I whispered that to the crimson swine, remembering the past encounters. Then, the crimson swine came closer with me and mocked Sakura-chan.
“Queeeeee!”
Sakura-chan kicked the crimson swine in the stomach, sending him spinning through the air. I dodged the kick.
“Bu-bu-bu-bu-hiiiii!”
“Ahhhhhhhhhhh, Miiiiiine, ahhhhhh, hahaha!”

Watching this, I felt a sense of relief in my chest. Well, after that, I just need to throw the unconscious crimson swine into the treatment center until he wakes up. The cart rattled as it carried Father and the others away.

Well… yeah. Sakura-chan has definitely grown into colors similar to Filo-tan’s. And then… when Sakura-chan transformed into the Filorial Queen form, Father went to the monster merchant to leave her there. It’s about time. I took the older sister from Shiltvelt and waited for the moment the monster merchant would bring Father in, late at night.
“What’s going on? We agreed to leave it until tomorrow, right?”
“I was planning to, but the hero’s monster has become somewhat of a problem.”
“Queeeeee!”

Sakura-chan was rampaging and destroying several cages. Right now, I’m watching from the back of the tent with big sister. Since it would be troublesome if there’s too much noise, I told her to quiet down a little, and I’ll introduce her to big sister’s big sister. Big sister seems to understand that she shouldn’t make a fuss, and is patiently holding herself back, trying not to rush over. She’s already been given medicine, and the sickness is completely cured.
“She destroyed about three iron cages, sent five subordinates to the treatment clinic while trying to subdue her, and three of the monsters she was controlling were heavily injured. Yes.”
“I’m not paying for that.”
“I’m in awe of how the hero always prioritizes money, even at times like this. Yes.”
I, too, am impressed.

Ah, Father is amazing, isn’t he? From this sense of monetary value, Filo-tan will be raised. And Father had heard about the Filorial-sama from the monster merchant. Soon, I could feel tears pouring from my eyes like a waterfall behind Father.
“…Sama?”
“Huh? Did I just hear a voice I didn’t recognize?”
“Well? I think I heard a voice like that too.”
“Oh?”
Big sister’s big sister was looking back and forth between Filo-tan and me.

It had some slight curly hair, but it was unmistakably Filo-tan! Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan!
“You’re Motoyasu! What are you doing here!?”
“Fiiiiiiiiiilooooooo-tannnnnn!”
“W-W-W-What!? Yaaaahhhhhh!”
It was a bothersome cage, but I rubbed my cheek against Filo-tan as much as I could.
It had been a very long journey, Filo-tan!
“U-Um… Sadina big sister?”
Big sister saw big sister’s big sister and started running to her, looking for help.
“Oh! Raftalia cha—”
At that moment, the world turned gray.
But I still didn’t stop rubbing my cheek against Filo-tan! Suddenly, big sister appeared from the space, and in my excited state, I said to her:
“How’s this, big sister! I met Filo-tan!”
Big sister looked around. Then, she looked at both big sister’s big sister and me.
Does her expression seem somewhat harsh? Or is it just my imagination?
“…Why am I in a child’s form, and why is Sadina-san here?”
“It’s just that a bad coincidence piled up, so big sister’s big sister helped out in place of big sister.”
Big sister staggered back.
“No, in the end, the crimson swine messed up, and Father moved without buying a slave, so I panicked.”
I explained the whole situation to big sister, who was slightly trembling.
“But I didn’t give up and kept going, and somehow it worked out!”
“Ugh… If I had to see this much, I could’ve waited one more round… If you hadn’t been tailing me…”
Big sister knelt down and groaned.
What’s wrong?
Ah, that’s right! I’m still hugging Filo-tan. Rubbing, sniffing…
“I’m needed by Naofumi-sama… Yes, that’s it. Even if I’m unnecessary in Filo’s development process, I’m still needed… We’re connected by the heart…”
Big sister started mumbling something.
Is it some kind of suggestion? What’s going on?
“With all the loops and events that happened, the fact that I’m here with Naofumi-sama… Ugh, no, this is fate. Ugh, why do Sadina-san and Naofumi-sama look so close? That’s my place…”

Big sister was saying something in pain, looking like she was struggling. I don’t want to tell big sister, “Filo-tan would’ve been born even without you.” That’s right, in the end, it was big sister’s big sister who made this happen. Big sister definitely has value. I rubbed more. Filo-tan, looking somewhat uncomfortable, stiffened up.
“Big sister, please stop freezing time. I need to keep rubbing Filo-tan’s cheek.”
“Do you even know why you wanted to meet Filo?”
“Of course. I came to meet Filo-tan!”
I answered with a firm expression.
What other meaning could there be?
However… I’m surprised that Sakura-chan could become Filo-tan depending on how things go.

“It’s not that. I’m doing this so I can return to Naofumi-sama, who’s fighting. Do you realize who’s to blame for the delay!? Ugh… I had to keep seeing these unpleasant things! You must have a grudge against me! Right!?”
“I have no such intention.”
“The fact that you have no ill will makes it even worse! You’re my enemy! I will never forgive you!”
Oh… Big sister is directing immense hostility toward me. No, that’s not it. I did everything with sincerity.
“In the end, Filo-tan was born, and that was lucky! A true miracle!”
“Ugh… Why do I have to bring a person like this along… Rifana-chan… For your resolve, I’ll accept this bitterness.”
“Now then, big sister, doesn’t this Filo-tan have to come with us?”
“No way!”
“No! No! I finally got to meet her!”
I threw a tantrum. However, in the original world, Filo-tan joined Father’s party this way.
“Be quiet!”
“Ugh!”
Big sister quickly enlarged a hammer and struck me on the top of the head. I couldn’t dodge, and I collapsed.
…Oh?
“Where am I?”
My memory is confused, and everything feels blurry. What was I doing? It feels like all this information is mixing together and confusing me.
“Are you going to say you have amnesia now?”
“Amnesia? I’m Motoyasu! The Love Hunter, loyal to Filo-tan and Father!”
“Sigh… Fine then.”
“Ah, Filo-tan—”

Before I could finish my sentence, big sister waved her hand, and the clock that was floating in my view shattered. Then, I felt my body float, and I was able to return to my original world. Well, I finally escaped the loop like this.
Now, Filo-tan! This Motoyasu is back to save you! It took a while to remember this time, and my speech was also strange.
